senses.gloss: &c., a corrupt. of אֶיגְוִיסְטְרִין m. (equestris, equester) one belonging to the equestrian order, knight, nobleman (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Eque).
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:7">Esth. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>אני א׳ של הק״בה וכ׳</he> (Yalk. a. l. 1054 … <he>איסגנטרינו של</he>) I am the Lord’s knight, for … my ancestor (Benjamin) was born in the Land of Israel. Yalk. l. c. <he>וכי א׳ וכ׳</he> does a knight bow before a commoner?
